VeraGrid.Gui.profile_wizard_utils.fill_substation_weather_profiles(bus: Bus, temperature: ndarray | None, wind_speed: ndarray | None, irradiation: ndarray | None, expected_size: int) → None[source]

Fill missing weather profiles on the substation associated with a bus.

Existing non-empty weather profiles are preserved. The MultiCircuit time profile length is used as the required size for all incoming arrays.

Parameters:

  • bus – Bus associated with the generated profile.

  • temperature – Air temperature profile in degrees Celsius.

  • wind_speed – Wind speed profile in m/s.

  • irradiation – Solar irradiation profile in W/m2.

  • expected_size – Expected MultiCircuit time profile length.

Returns:

Nothing.

QTableView with an Excel-like fill handle on the current cell. Dragging the handle down copies the current cell value to the selected range.

VeraGrid integration note: Replace an existing .ui QTableView (for example dataStructureTableView) by promoting it in Qt Designer to this class:
